overview: Regex Debugger Sheet is a compact one-page reference for developers who need common regex syntax, anchors, quantifiers, and flags at a glance. It includes 16 copy-paste patterns and a flag cheat sheet to speed up everyday matching tasks. It is designed as a quick lookup aid, not a full regex course or engine-specific guarantee.
usecases: You are debugging a failing validation rule and need to quickly check anchor or quantifier syntax.
You are writing a new input pattern and want a safe starting template before customizing it.
You are onboarding a junior developer and need a shared, concise regex reference during code review.
howto: Open it in your PDF viewer or browser.
Copy the relevant pattern or flag notation into your regex tool or code.

faq.q: Will every pattern work exactly the same in my regex engine?
faq.a: No, always test patterns in your specific engine and context before using them in production.

faq.q: Is this a complete regex tutorial?
faq.a: No, it is a concise reference sheet for common syntax and patterns rather than an in-depth learning guide.
